discovered_objects.exact_quotation: What the public story gets right, gets wrong, overstates, and how to state the defensible version.
discovered_objects.neutral_paraphrase: A framework for evaluating a public narrative by separating accurate claims, errors, exaggerations, and a more defensible formulation.
discovered_objects.referent: The public story as an object of evaluation
identity_conditions: The public story is the same if it is the narrative being assessed
The public story is the same if it has claims that can be right, wrong, or overstated
distinctions: Right versus wrong versus overstated versus defensible
relations: The defensible version is derived from the public story
Overstatement is a type of inaccuracy distinct from being wrong
operations: Identify what the public story gets right
Identify what the public story gets wrong
Identify what the public story overstates
dependencies: Requires a public story to exist
Requires criteria for rightness, wrongness, and overstatement
constraints: The defensible version must be stated without overstating
The evaluation must be supported by evidence
invariants: The public story remains the object of evaluation
The categories of right, wrong, overstated, and defensible remain distinct
consequences: A defensible version can be produced
The public story may be revised or replaced
countermodels: A public story with no claims that can be right or wrong
A public story that is entirely accurate and not overstated
collapse_conditions: If the public story is identical to the defensible version, the distinction collapses
If all claims are both right and wrong, the categories collapse
open_questions: What is the content of the public story?
What criteria determine rightness and wrongness?

discovered_objects.exact_quotation: The public story may say this strongly without stopping to prove it inline. This tangent is where the support, objections, and receipts accumulate.
discovered_objects.neutral_paraphrase: A location for accumulating evidence, counterarguments, and documentation related to a strong claim made in the public story.
discovered_objects.referent: The tangent section for support, objections, and receipts
identity_conditions: The tangent is the same if it is the section where support, objections, and receipts accumulate
The tangent is the same if it is distinct from the inline proof
relations: The tangent supports the public story's strong claim
Objections and receipts are collected in the tangent
operations: Refer to the tangent from the public story
dependencies: Requires a strong claim in the public story
Requires a tangent section to exist
constraints: The tangent does not prove the claim inline
The tangent is separate from the main narrative
invariants: The tangent remains the place for support, objections, and receipts
The strong claim remains unproven inline
consequences: The public story can make strong claims without immediate proof
Readers can find supporting material in the tangent
countermodels: A public story that proves all claims inline
A tangent that contains no support, objections, or receipts
collapse_conditions: If the tangent becomes the main narrative, the distinction collapses
If the strong claim is proven inline, the tangent becomes redundant

discovered_objects.neutral_paraphrase: References to two other documents: one about a public story and one about a ledger of objections and proofs.
discovered_objects.referent: Two linked documents: a public story and a ledger of objections and proofs
identity_conditions: The references are the same if they point to the same two documents
The references are the same if the documents have the same content
distinctions: Public story document versus ledger document
relations: The ledger document is related to objections and proofs
The public story document is related to the public story
operations: Navigate to the public story document
Use the ledger to support or refute claims
dependencies: Requires the referenced documents to exist
constraints: The references are not inline content
The documents are external to this section
invariants: The references point to the same documents
The ledger contains objections and proofs
consequences: The public story can be checked against the ledger
countermodels: The referenced documents do not exist
The ledger contains no objections or proofs
collapse_conditions: If the two documents are merged, the distinction collapses
If the references are broken, the link collapses
open_questions: What is the content of the public story document?
What objections and proofs are in the ledger?

discovered_objects.neutral_paraphrase: A placeholder indicating that content is to be added later.
identity_conditions: The placeholder is the same if it indicates pending expansion
The placeholder is the same if it is in the same section
relations: The placeholder relates to future content
The placeholder is a marker for missing information
operations: Replace the placeholder with actual text
dependencies: Requires future content to be written
constraints: The placeholder does not provide information
invariants: The placeholder remains pending until expanded
consequences: Readers cannot rely on the placeholder for content
countermodels: A section with no placeholder and full content
A placeholder that is never expanded
collapse_conditions: If the placeholder is expanded, it ceases to be a placeholder
If the section is removed, the placeholder disappears

discovered_objects.neutral_paraphrase: A placeholder indicating that a mapping is to be provided later.
identity_conditions: The placeholder is the same if it indicates pending mapping
The placeholder is the same if it is in the same section
relations: The placeholder relates to a future mapping
The mapping is distinct from expansion
operations: Replace the placeholder with the mapping
dependencies: Requires a mapping to be defined
constraints: The placeholder does not provide mapping
invariants: The placeholder remains pending until mapped
consequences: Readers cannot rely on the placeholder for mapping
countermodels: A section with a complete mapping
A placeholder that is never mapped
collapse_conditions: If the mapping is provided, the placeholder ceases to exist
If the section is removed, the placeholder disappears
open_questions: When will the mapping be provided?

discovered_objects.referent: A table of questions and pending answers
identity_conditions: The table is the same if it has the same four questions
The table is the same if the answers are pending
distinctions: Right versus wrong versus overstated versus defensible
relations: Each question has a corresponding answer
The defensible version is related to the other three questions
operations: Evaluate what was right, wrong, and overstated
dependencies: Requires the public story to be evaluated
Requires criteria for rightness, wrongness, and overstatement
invariants: The four questions remain the same
The answers are pending until filled
consequences: The table can be completed with evaluations
The defensible version can be stated
collapse_conditions: If the answers are filled, the pending status collapses
If the table is removed, the structure collapses

global_open_questions: What is the content of the public story?
What criteria determine rightness, wrongness, and overstatement?
What is the strong claim that requires support?
What are the contents of the referenced documents?
What will be expanded and mapped in the pending sections?
prohibited_outputs: No discipline, domain, object type, claim class, proof class, warrant, evidence grade, bridge grade, theological identification, canonical status, or publication status assigned.
No inference of adjacency as dependency.
No treatment of placeholders as substantive content.

emergent_organization.organization_name: Emergent Organization of Evaluative and Referential Fragments
emergent_organization.organizing_principle: Grouping by the primary function each discovery serves in relation to a central public story: evaluation, support, reference, or placeholder status.

groupings.label: Evaluation Frameworks
groupings.definition: Discoveries that provide a structure for assessing the accuracy and defensibility of a public narrative.
groupings.rationale: DISC-0001 outlines the categories of right, wrong, overstated, and defensible, while DISC-0006 operationalizes these categories in a table format with pending answers. Both are directly concerned with evaluating a public story.

groupings.label: Support and Evidence Accumulation
groupings.definition: Discoveries that describe or point to locations where supporting material, objections, and proofs are gathered.
groupings.rationale: DISC-0002 explicitly describes a tangent for accumulating support, objections, and receipts. DISC-0003 references a ledger of objections and proofs, which serves a similar evidence-gathering function. Both relate to backing up claims made in the public story.

groupings.label: Placeholders for Future Content
groupings.definition: Discoveries that indicate incomplete sections awaiting expansion or mapping.
groupings.rationale: Both DISC-0004 and DISC-0005 are explicit placeholders: one for expansion, one for mapping. They share the characteristic of signaling that content is pending and the section is incomplete.

cross_group_tensions.tension: The evaluation frameworks (DISC-0001, DISC-0006) are closely tied to the support and evidence accumulation group (DISC-0002, DISC-0003) because the defensible version in the evaluation likely relies on the support and objections collected in the tangent and ledger.

The placeholders (DISC-0004, DISC-0005) may eventually become part of the evaluation or support groups once expanded, creating a temporal tension between current placeholder status and future content.

rival_organizations.organizing_principle: Grouping based on whether discoveries reference external documents or are self-contained.

groupings.label: Referential
groupings.definition: Discoveries that explicitly link to other documents or sections.

groupings.label: Non-referential
groupings.definition: Discoveries that do not reference external documents.

rival_organizations.organizing_principle: Grouping based on whether the discovery contains complete content or is pending.

groupings.label: Complete
groupings.definition: Discoveries that provide full information without pending markers.

groupings.label: Pending
groupings.definition: Discoveries that explicitly indicate missing or future content.

cautions: The groupings are based solely on the provided text and may not reflect the original author's intended categories.
Some discoveries, like DISC-0006, contain pending answers and may later shift in function once completed.
The references in DISC-0003 are not expanded, so the exact nature of the linked documents is unknown.
The placeholders (DISC-0004, DISC-0005) are temporary and may be removed or transformed, affecting the stability of the placeholder group.
